verses.en: Paul, a prisoner of Jesus Christ, and Timothy our brother, unto Philemon our dearly beloved, and fellowlabourer,
verses.pt: Paulo, prisioneiro de Cristo Jesus, e o irmão Timóteo, ao amado Filemom, nosso companheiro de trabalho,
verses.en_web: Paul, a prisoner of Christ Jesus, and Timothy our brother, to Philemon, our beloved fellow worker,
verses.en_bbe: Paul, a prisoner of Jesus Christ, and Timothy our brother, to Philemon, our dear helper in the faith,

verses.en: And to our beloved Apphia, and Archippus our fellowsoldier, and to the church in thy house:
verses.pt: e à nossa irmã Áfia, e a Arquipo, nosso companheiro de lutas, e à igreja que está em tua casa:
verses.en_web: to the beloved Apphia, to Archippus, our fellow soldier, and to the assembly in your house:
verses.en_bbe: And to Apphia, our sister, and to Archippus, our brother in God's army, and to the church in your house:

verses.en: Grace to you, and peace, from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
verses.pt: Graças a vós, e paz da parte de Deus nosso Pai, e do Senhor Jesus Cristo.
verses.en_web: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
verses.en_bbe: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

verses.en: I thank my God, making mention of thee always in my prayers,
verses.pt: Sempre dou graças ao meu Deus, lembrando-me de ti nas minhas orações,
verses.en_web: I thank my God always, making mention of you in my prayers,
verses.en_bbe: I give praise to God at all times and make prayer for you,

verses.en: Hearing of thy love and faith, which thou hast toward the Lord Jesus, and toward all saints;
verses.pt: ao ouvir falar do amor e da fé que tens para com o Senhor Jesus e para com todos os santos;
verses.en_web: hearing of your love, and of the faith which you have toward the Lord Jesus, and toward all the saints;
verses.en_bbe: Hearing of the love and the faith which you have to the Lord Jesus and to all the saints;

verses.en: That the communication of thy faith may become effectual by the acknowledging of every good thing which is in you in Christ Jesus.
verses.pt: para que a comunicação da tua fé se torne eficaz, no pleno conhecimento de todo o bem que em nós há para com Cristo.
verses.en_web: that the fellowship of your faith may become effective, in the knowledge of every good thing which is in us in Christ Jesus.
verses.en_bbe: That the faith which you have in common with them may be working with power, in the knowledge of every good thing in you, for Christ.

verses.en: For we have great joy and consolation in thy love, because the bowels of the saints are refreshed by thee, brother.
verses.pt: Pois tive grande gozo e consolação no teu amor, porque por ti, irmão, os corações dos santos têm sido reanimados.
verses.en_web: For we have much joy and comfort in your love, because the hearts of the saints have been refreshed through you, brother.
verses.en_bbe: For I had great joy and comfort in your love, because the hearts of the saints have been made strong again through you, brother.

verses.en: Wherefore, though I might be much bold in Christ to enjoin thee that which is convenient,
verses.pt: Pelo que, embora tenha em Cristo plena liberdade para te mandar o que convém,
verses.en_web: Therefore though I have all boldness in Christ to command you that which is appropriate,
verses.en_bbe: And so, though I might, in the name of Christ, give you orders to do what is right,

verses.en: Yet for love’s sake I rather beseech thee, being such an one as Paul the aged, and now also a prisoner of Jesus Christ.
verses.pt: todavia prefiro rogar-te por esse teu amor, sendo eu como sou, Paulo o velho, e agora até prisioneiro de Cristo Jesus,
verses.en_web: yet for love’s sake I rather beg, being such a one as Paul, the aged, but also a prisoner of Jesus Christ.
verses.en_bbe: Still, because of love, in place of an order, I make a request to you, I, Paul, an old man and now a prisoner of Christ Jesus:

verses.en: I beseech thee for my son Onesimus, whom I have begotten in my bonds:
verses.pt: sim, rogo-te por meu filho Onésimo, que gerei nas minhas prisões;
verses.en_web: I beg you for my child, whom I have become the father of in my chains, Onesimus,
verses.en_bbe: My request is for my child Onesimus, the child of my chains,

verses.en: Which in time past was to thee unprofitable, but now profitable to thee and to me:
verses.pt: o qual outrora te foi inútil, mas agora a ti e a mim é muito útil;
verses.en_web: who once was useless to you, but now is useful to you and to me.
verses.en_bbe: Who in the past was of no profit to you, but now is of profit to you and to me:

verses.en: Whom I have sent again: thou therefore receive him, that is, mine own bowels:
verses.pt: eu to torno a enviar, a ele que é o meu próprio coração.
verses.en_web: I am sending him back. Therefore receive him, that is, my own heart,
verses.en_bbe: Whom I have sent back to you, him who is my very heart:

verses.en: Whom I would have retained with me, that in thy stead he might have ministered unto me in the bonds of the gospel:
verses.pt: Eu bem quisera retê-lo comigo, para que em teu lugar me servisse nas prisões do evangelho;
verses.en_web: whom I desired to keep with me, that on your behalf he might serve me in my chains for the Good News.
verses.en_bbe: Though my desire was to keep him with me, to be my servant in the chains of the good news, in your place:

verses.en: But without thy mind would I do nothing; that thy benefit should not be as it were of necessity, but willingly.
verses.pt: mas sem o teu consentimento nada quis fazer, para que o teu benefício não fosse como por força, mas, sim, espontâneo.
verses.en_web: But I was willing to do nothing without your consent, that your goodness would not be as of necessity, but of free will.
verses.en_bbe: But without your approval I would do nothing; so that your good works might not be forced, but done freely from your heart.

verses.en: For perhaps he therefore departed for a season, that thou shouldest receive him for ever;
verses.pt: Porque bem pode ser que ele se tenha separado de ti por algum tempo, para que o recobrasses para sempre,
verses.en_web: For perhaps he was therefore separated from you for a while, that you would have him forever,
verses.en_bbe: For it is possible that for this reason he was parted from you for a time, so that you might have him for ever;

verses.en: Not now as a servant, but above a servant, a brother beloved, specially to me, but how much more unto thee, both in the flesh, and in the Lord?
verses.pt: não já como escravo, antes mais do que escravo, como irmão amado, particularmente de mim, e quanto mais de ti, tanto na carne como também no Senhor.
verses.en_web: no longer as a slave, but more than a slave, a beloved brother, especially to me, but how much rather to you, both in the flesh and in the Lord.
verses.en_bbe: No longer as a servant, but more than a servant, a brother, very dear to me specially, but much more to you, in the flesh as well as in the Lord.

verses.en: If thou count me therefore a partner, receive him as myself.
verses.pt: Assim pois, se me tens por companheiro, recebe-o como a mim mesmo.
verses.en_web: If then you count me a partner, receive him as you would receive me.
verses.en_bbe: If then you take me to be your friend and brother, take him in as myself.

verses.en: If he hath wronged thee, or oweth thee ought, put that on mine account;
verses.pt: E, se te fez algum dano, ou te deve alguma coisa, lança-o minha conta.
verses.en_web: But if he has wronged you at all, or owes you anything, put that to my account.
verses.en_bbe: If he has done you any wrong or is in debt to you for anything, put it to my account.

verses.en: I Paul have written it with mine own hand, I will repay it: albeit I do not say to thee how thou owest unto me even thine own self besides.
verses.pt: Eu, Paulo, de meu próprio punho o escrevo, eu o pagarei, para não te dizer que ainda a ti mesmo a mim te deves.
verses.en_web: I, Paul, write this with my own hand: I will repay it (not to mention to you that you owe to me even your own self besides).
verses.en_bbe: I, Paul, writing this myself, say, I will make payment to you: and I do not say to you that you are in debt to me even for your life.

verses.en: Yea, brother, let me have joy of thee in the Lord: refresh my bowels in the Lord.
verses.pt: Sim, irmão, eu quisera regozijar-me de ti no Senhor; reanima o meu coração em Cristo.
verses.en_web: Yes, brother, let me have joy from you in the Lord. Refresh my heart in the Lord.
verses.en_bbe: So brother, let me have joy of you in the Lord: give new life to my heart in Christ.

verses.en: Having confidence in thy obedience I wrote unto thee, knowing that thou wilt also do more than I say.
verses.pt: Escrevo-te confiado na tua obediência, sabendo que farás ainda mais do que peço.
verses.en_web: Having confidence in your obedience, I write to you, knowing that you will do even beyond what I say.
verses.en_bbe: Being certain that you will do my desire, I am writing to you, in the knowledge that you will do even more than I say.

verses.en: But withal prepare me also a lodging: for I trust that through your prayers I shall be given unto you.
verses.pt: E ao mesmo tempo, prepara-me também pousada, pois espero que pelas vossas orações hei de ser concedido.
verses.en_web: Also, prepare a guest room for me, for I hope that through your prayers I will be restored to you.
verses.en_bbe: And make a room ready for me; for I am hoping that through your prayers I will be given to you.

verses.en: There salute thee Epaphras, my fellowprisoner in Christ Jesus;
verses.pt: Saúda-te Epafras, meu companheiro de prisão em Cristo Jesus,
verses.en_web: Epaphras, my fellow prisoner in Christ Jesus, greets you,
verses.en_bbe: Epaphras, my brother-prisoner in Christ Jesus, sends you his love;

verses.en: Marcus, Aristarchus, Demas, Lucas, my fellowlabourers.
verses.pt: assim como Marcos, Aristarco, Demas e Lucas, meus cooperadores.
verses.en_web: as do Mark, Aristarchus, Demas, and Luke, my fellow workers.
verses.en_bbe: And so do Mark, Aristarchus, Demas, and Luke, my brother-workers.

verses.en: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit. Amen.
verses.pt: A graça do Senhor Jesus Cristo seja com o vosso espírito.
verses.en_web: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit. Amen.
verses.en_bbe: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit. So be it.
